Feline akh's have harder hitting attacks than Salawas, and a special attack which deals high magic damage and makes nearby feline akh's aggressive towards you. This occurs when the mob reaches 2500 life points, and hits when the bar above their head fully charges. Despite this, they can very easily be AFK'd in the same method as Salawas, and are often killed for their common elite clue drops
. Due to their harder hitting attacks, the usage of a vampyrism scrimshaw
is recommended, as the player should be praying

Due to their low life points their dangerous special attack can be ignored. After 5 auto-attacks, they strike the floor to deal a large 3000 hit through deflect prayers. With a good setup they can be AFK'd. At 105 Slayer
it is possible to use Wilder Pies to boost, to kill these; however, at 111 Slayer
it is recommended to move on to the Imperial akhs via the usage of a Wilder Pie.
